data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew and Greek words 'El' (God) and 'shamah' (to hear, attend), Isman can be interpreted as 'God's helper' or 'one who hears and obeys God'. This name was given to individuals who were devoted to their faith and served as spiritual guides to their communities. The name Isman carries the meaning “God's helper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Isman usually hope their child will grow to embody god's helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
